subject: Quick note on Example Roofing Co. and the competitor gap I noticed
body:
Hi,

Rival Roofing Exampleville ranks #1 for 'emergency roof repair exampleville' and Example Roofing Co. does not appear in the top 10 for that term.

That's real search volume going to a name your prospects already recognize as a competitor, not to you.

I put together a quick 3-point comparison against them if useful -- no obligation either way, just flagging something specific to Example Roofing Co. rather than a generic pitch.

Ali
